strapline: Preserving History · Honouring Our Forefathers · Inspiring Future Generations
guiding_principle: Preserve History for the Coming Generation.

hero.title: History: Church of Pakistan
hero.intro: History: Church of Pakistan is a platform dedicated to informing the present and coming generations about the contributions, sacrifices, and service of our forefathers who helped shape the life and witness of the Church and its people in Pakistan.
hero.purpose: Our purpose is to preserve historical memories and make them accessible through photographs, published documents, family records, and personal memories.

purpose_cards.title: Pictorial History & Facts
purpose_cards.copy: To share historical photographs and factual information drawn from published books, documents, church records, and other reliable sources.

purpose_cards.title: Untold Stories
purpose_cards.copy: To bring to light lesser-known stories and events, based on documented historical evidence.

purpose_cards.title: Preserving Family Memories
purpose_cards.copy: To recover and preserve the memories, photographs, and personal stories of deceased church leaders through their families and those who knew them.

purpose_cards.title: Honouring Those Who Served
purpose_cards.copy: To pay tribute to both clergy and laypeople, living and deceased, who contributed to the Church and served their communities.

connection: I am a Christian and a born member of the Church of Pakistan.
Curator-provided connection copy: I served as a Member of the Executive Committee of the Church of Pakistan from 1991 to 2017.

Curator-provided family connection copy: My father, Rt. Rev. Bishop Johnston Safdar Qadir Bakhsh, served as a Bishop and Moderator of the Church of Pakistan and devoted his life to the service of the Church.
This page is therefore not only a historical project but also a personal commitment to preserve the heritage and living memories of the Church of Pakistan for generations to come.

timeline.title: Sialkot
timeline.copy: First stone laid for Holy Trinity Cathedral Church.

timeline.title: Lahore
timeline.copy: The Diocese of Lahore source records the Cathedral Church of the Resurrection as constructed/completed in 1887; its source URL is currently unreachable and no alternate URL is confirmed.

timeline.title: Church Union
timeline.copy: Church of Pakistan formed through the union of Anglican, Methodist, Lutheran and Scottish Presbyterian traditions.

timeline.title: Eight Dioceses
timeline.copy: Hyderabad, Raiwind, Faisalabad and Peshawar created in addition to Karachi, Multan, Lahore and Sialkot.

timeline.title: Raiwind
timeline.copy: The Diocese of Raiwind dedicated its new cathedral at Warris Road, Lahore.

page_context.contribute_eyebrow: Your family may hold a missing piece of history
page_context.contribute_copy: Contribute photographs, documents, family memories, corrections, or information that can help preserve the story faithfully for future generations.
page_context.guiding_note: We believe that history belongs to everyone. Our aim is to preserve it faithfully, respectfully, and responsibly, so that future generations can learn from the people, events, sacrifices, and achievements that shaped the Church of Pakistan.
page_context.archive_intro: Published Family Archive holdings. Each item carries provenance and a verification note. Captions follow the source Facebook page unless otherwise marked.
page_context.interviews_intro: Youth motivational programs from the History: Church of Pakistan Facebook page (Rab Ki Khidmat / Youth Empowerment). Captions follow the page inventory; no invented names.
page_context.people_intro: Biographical records for clergy and laypeople will be published here only from verified sources. This page does not invent sample biographies.
page_context.contribute_intro: Share photographs, documents, family memories, corrections, or information that can help preserve the story faithfully. Contributions are reviewed for rights and citations before any publication.
